en_US: Pokémon get more friendly if you
spend time with them.
They can shine like a bright light--
like a beacon at night to guide us...
They can take us across the water on
their backs when we are without
a boat...
Pokémon are helping us everywhere.
I can’t imagine a life without them!
There’s a person in Cianwood City
across the sea.
I heard him bragging about his
rare Pokémon.
...There!
All done!
It’s sure to surprise anyone!
Oh, are you a Trainer?
You came at just the right time!
I just finished putting my Ball Capsule
on my Poké Ball.
Do you want to battle and be
amazed by my decoration? {YESNO 0}
All right!
Here I come!
You can turn your Poké Balls into your
own special creations by adding Seals.
How cool is it to have a Poké Ball that
only you have in the entire world?
Give it a whirl!
Oh, remember to put the Ball Capsule
on a Poké Ball once it’s ready!
Oh, really?
Talk to me if you want to see my
Ball Capsule sometime!
Now you want to see my Ball Capsule?
Battle me so I can show it to you! {YESNO 0}
